sourceText:
Spiced Sour Cherry Chocolate Ice Cream
By: Spoonabilities
Published: Monday, August 29, 2016 - 6:22pm

Ingredients




1 pint premium chocolate ice cream, softened slightly
½ cup chilled Spiced Sour Cherry Spread
1 TableSpoon cherry brandy or brandy or Grand Marnier (optional)

Preparation

1 Let ice cream soften in the refrigerator for about an hour. (TIP: set a timer to remember it's in there) 2 Stir together ice cream, Spiced Sour Cherry Spread and cherry brandy. 3 Transfer to plastic container; cover and freeze until firm.

About

Semi-homemade Spiced Sour Cherry Chocolate Ice Cream is one of the easiest 1-2-3 recipes at Spoonabilities. You just need to get a pint (or more) of chocolate ice cream at the supermarket, let it soften in the refrigerator for about an hour, add the Spiced Sour Cherry Spread, refreeze and voila!
